experiment.hypothesis: Retail may express the voice scan as a byte-pointer cursor recurrence rather than an integer byte offset. Keeping the cursor live across calls could change MWCC's nonvolatile interference graph and rotate selected/loop/id into retail r31/r30/r29 while materializing the destination voice separately.
